messages:
ben_sales: Wrapping up Nimbus Health deal — passing to CS for onboarding + support triage. Contract: $180k ARR, Dedicated GPUs (reserved), Private deployment (VPC), 12‑month term, renewal in ~11 months. PO attached.
ben_sales: Key asks: HIPAA-compliant logs retention, Okta SSO, later on-prem connector for PHI sync, and 99.9% availability with p95 latency <120ms. They will require us-east data residency.
maria_cs: Thanks — noted. Can you paste the signed PO and any SSO/contact info here?
ben_sales: PO: https://drive.redwood.com/nimbus_signed_po.pdf ; Sales notes: https://docs.redwood.com/deals/nimbus-summary ; Okta tenant id: nimbus-prod-okta, contact: claire@nimbus.health. Kickoff target: 2028-04-02.
olivia_onboard: Looping in onboarding. Do they plan to use embeddings or custom models? Any expected throughput patterns beyond the burst ask?
ben_sales: They want clinical-curie-v1 (fine-tuned) for triage + embeddings for semantic search. Expected burst: up to 500 rps for first 2 weeks, then steady 120 rps. Also expect large batch exports for analytics monthly.
nate_support: Creating support ticket for network/routing checks and private deploy triage. Ticket: CS-2318. I'll add initial traceroute logs.
kevin_eng: From infra: we need VPC peering details, proposed CIDR, and a perf plan. I'll run an initial synthetic perf run after we have staging access. ETA 48h post-kickoff.
maria_cs: Risks we should track: 1) latency SLO might require quant/optimization; 2) SCIM/Okta mapping unknown; 3) renewal sensitivity — they want <2% error rate in first 90 days or procurement will ask for concessions.
ben_sales: Customer contacts: Claire (technical lead) claire@nimbus.health, Raj (CMO/procurement). Procurement asked for monthly usage + per-route cost breakdowns.
olivia_onboard: Proposed owners: maria_cs (CS lead); olivia_onboard (onboarding lead); nate_support (support triage); kevin_eng (eng perf & private deploy); ben_sales (sales escalation). I'll create kickoff invite and base runbook.
maria_cs: Action items: 1) Olivia to schedule kickoff with Claire/Raj by 2028-03-28. 2) Nate to open CS-2318 with network checklist (in progress). 3) Kevin to perf test and post results. 4) Olivia to capture prompt/trace tests for quality monitoring. 5) CS to schedule 30/60/90 health check cadence and renewal alerts.
nate_support: CS-2318 created: https://support.redwood.com/cs-2318 — attached network checklist and initial traceroute showing intermittent packet loss; need customer VPN config and firewall rules.
ben_sales: Copying legal & procurement on kickoff; they want encryption-at-rest + KMS integration docs and SOC overview.
maria_cs: I'll spin up the Nimbus onboarding doc in Confluence and paste link here when ready.
olivia_onboard: Kickoff scheduled for 2028-04-02 14:00 PT — invite sent to Claire, Raj, legal, and infra. I'll run demo and request anonymized sample prompts/data ingestion playbook.
kevin_eng: Perf test plan: run 1k synthetic prompts, capture p95/p99 / token cost. If p95 >120ms, test with grpc batching (batch=4) and INT8 quant. Command I'll run: perf-run --model clinical-curie-v1 --n 1000 --batch 4. Will post raw numbers to thread.
maria_cs: Owners recap: maria_cs (CS lead), olivia_onboard (onboarding), nate_support (support), kevin_eng (eng). Renewal owner: ben_sales. Renewal risk: medium-high until 90-day health window.
ben_sales: Also note they want single-tenant logging separation and an audit for log access. I'll get SOC looped in.
kevin_eng: I'll need an anonymized sample set (staging) to validate quality/regression after quantization. Olivia — can you request during kickoff?
olivia_onboard: Will request anonymized sample set and ingestion playbook in kickoff. Also will capture initial quality checks and deliver a first-pass report to maria_cs.
maria_cs: Thanks all. I'll draft the CS playbook and share: https://confluence.redwood.com/cs/nimbus-onboarding (draft). We'll open a 30-day checkpoint thread after first deploy to surface metrics and any escalations.
nate_support: Triage notes done for today; pinging @oncall-infra for DNS and peering verification.
jira-bot: CS-2318 transitioned to "Waiting on Customer" by nate_support.
ben_sales: One more ask from customer: weekly status email for first 8 weeks. Olivia — can you own cadence and dashboard snapshot?
olivia_onboard: Yes — weekly status email + dashboard snapshot (latency, error rate, token usage). I'll draft and post template here.
maria_cs: Final note: set Renewal Alert (90/60/30 days) and health pulses; categorize as medium-high renewal risk until we prove <2% error and p95 latency target. I'll follow up with owners on 30-day check-in."
